corrections.old: The king of Lungtung mingled among them;
corrections.new: Their governor khan mingled among them;
corrections.note: Primary Tumenbaeva PDF4 explicitly identifies луңтуң as Chinese local headman/district or military governor and quotes this exact beaded-plume/coral stanza (Semetey I78). Rendered governor khan, not invented place Lungtung. Genitive/title construction awkward in source; rank kept general. https://nbisu.moy.su/_ld/10/1088_Tumenbaeva_J.A..pdf

corrections.old: Mingled with the village headman's blood—
corrections.new: With the lungtung khan among them,
corrections.note: Corrected after individual PDF246 image/context reread: луӊтуӊ Chinese official rank; каны read as khan in enumeration, not headman blood. Primary Tumenbaeva, Chinese Words in Manas, PDF4 quotes exact Шуру отогот маржан таш / Луңтуңдун каны аралаш paired with Калдайдын каны аралаш and explains governor/headman rank: https://nbisu.moy.su/_ld/10/1088_Tumenbaeva_J.A..pdf . Slaughter context remains in adjacent verses; no named official invented.

corrections.old: The Chinese adorned with precious stones,
corrections.new: The Chinese officials with hat buttons,
corrections.note: Primary Yudakhin таш I sense 5 and the quoted таш сайынган Kalmyk-chief formula under таза establish rank-marking buttons/balls on Chinese officials’ hats; not generic precious-stone ornament. Read with adjacent best-of-them verse after individual PDF293 review. Raw unchanged.

corrections.old: He paid no heed to his finery.
corrections.new: He paid no heed to the best of them.
corrections.note: Personally re-inspected PDF293 and adjacent verses. Primary Yudakhin таза sense 3 лучший quotes таш сайынган калмактын тазасын сойгон жери бар, glossing the best Kalmyk chiefs; hence best of them, not finery. Raw unchanged.

Personally re-inspected PDF293 and full adjacent source passage. Tumenbaeva, «Манас» эпосунда кытай сөздөрүнүн колдонулушу, https://nbisu.moy.su/_ld/10/1088_Tumenbaeva_J.A..pdf PDF4 lines145–151, gives lungtung as Chinese headman/governor and quotes this exact beaded-adornment stanza with parallel Калдайдын каны аралаш. Read каны as khan, among the assembled chiefs, rather than blood mixed with ornaments. Title retained; precise institutional equivalence uncertain. This contextual interpretation corrects the prior blood reading; raw source unchanged.
